shares are trending on Thursday night.
Shares of the Massachusetts-based biotechnology and pharmaceutical company edged 0.087% higher to $194.99 in after-hours trading on Thursday.

Trial Data Takes Center Stage

The stock was seen moving after Moderna announced earlier this week that three abstracts on intismeran autogene, its investigational mRNA-based individualized neoantigen therapy, were accepted for presentation at the
European Society for Medical Oncology
Congress 2026 in Madrid. The congress is scheduled for Oct. 23 to 27.
